title: Yes-or-No Object · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Yes-or-No Object · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead secretly chooses a familiar object in the room. The other players ask only yes-or-no questions until they identify the object. The group identifies the object within ten questions. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Yes-or-No Object, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group identifies the object within ten questions.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group identifies the object within ten questions.
